Loop 5 of the position-tier-gate / full-trace arm. Prior context: loops 1-4 full_reasoning + NOTES.md.

Loops 1-4 findings: all cap changes and flow gates either fail or degrade. Loop 5 tries directional-aware position cap: only block same-direction concurrent opens; allow counter-direction opens. The reasoning: oracle CLOSE+OPEN simultaneously sends one CLOSE (reduce-only) and one OPEN. The OPEN's direction is OPPOSITE to the closing position (oracle reverses positions). With directional cap, the OPEN (opposite direction to existing) is always allowed — this is why the result is identical to simple: every oracle-generated OPEN is counter-direction to the existing position at that moment, so the directional gate never fires. Result: ptg-f-l5 = simple baseline (-96.34% vs base).

Key finding: The oracle signals ALWAYS reverse position direction. The directional-aware cap (allow counter-direction) = allow ALL oracle opens = simple baseline. The cap=1 mechanism works precisely because the CLOSE+OPEN arrive simultaneously — the OPEN sees the old position (same direction as CLOSE). The directional-aware version sees OPPOSITE direction (because the new OPEN goes the other way) and allows it unconditionally.
